description: Page listSavedQueries by cursor. The operation takes `cursor` and `limit` query parameters and answers { status, requestId, result: [...], limit, nextCursor } (the spec describes nextCursor as 'Cursor for the next page, to be sent as the `cursor` query parameter. Null on the last page.'). The converter's cursor detection does not recognise `nextCursor`, so the list was a single-page call. Observed live 2026-11-12: GET .../services/{serviceId}/saved-queries with limit=1 answered 200 with an empty result (request id ae1b674a-4f14-4fbd-b6f3-fcb0e8df9070). The multi-page traversal was captured on listApiKeys, which answers the same envelope.
